Verification criteria: After the router leaves a timed-out attempt, its late tool call runs no tool and sends no further provider request, in sync and async.
Risk to probe: an order or a before/after boundary its requirement names is broken

Propose at most 2 defects a developer could plausibly introduce that realize the risk.

proposals.defect: Executes the request before checking if the attempt was left, breaking the before/after boundary.
proposals.replacement:
def execute(self, request: ProviderRequest) -> ProviderResult:
        """Start the request only while the attempt is not left."""
        result = self._adapter.execute(request)
        _stop_if_left(self._left)
        return result
